title: Chapter 508
text:
Harmon had just been chased out of his mother planet and needed a War League. Han Xiao's display of strength had gained Harmon's recognition, and both sides had reached an agreement. Han Xiao would join the War League while Harmon would join the mercenary group. Becoming a mercenary would give Harmon ample opportunities to fight, which was what he needed.

Therefore, Harmon was not a direct member of the mercenary group, but more like a partner with equal status.

Other than the Lucky Halo, there were some similarities between the main character type characters. For example, some of them had extended events and plots, some of them had their own personalities and ideals, and some of them had their own strength or potential. Harmon belonged to the type of people who had their own strength.

The Luhan Beastmen believed in the warrior's path. In the Rockfall Tribe, where Harmon belonged, he had long been famous and was known as the "Roaring Beast". This was the Luhan Tribe's praise for powerful warriors. He was a good candidate for the chief position. Simply speaking, Harmon belonged to the type of main character who was very strong from the start.

Han Xiao's relationship with him was neither close nor far. Harmon adhered to the traditions of the War League, so he did not hesitate to fight for Han Xiao. Warriors were never indecisive.

Harmon had challenged almost all the officers in the mercenary group. Everyone knew that the longer he dragged on, the more powerful he became. He was like an unkillable cockroach that was very difficult to deal with. None of the officers had absolute confidence in defeating him — except for Aroshia. No matter how strong Harmon was, he could not cut down an energy body. This was his weakness.

Han Xiao had no interest in competing with Harmon in terms of endurance. It was better to end the battle as soon as possible.

"Roar —"

Harmon let out a roar. His powerful lung capacity caused the air to vibrate. Dragging his warhammer, he charged forward once again. Every step he took caused the metal floor to rumble as he closed in at an extremely fast speed.

Clatter —

Facing the charge, Han Xiao did not move. Two compressed orbs fell from his sleeves. The moment they touched the ground, electricity flashed and the orbs transformed into two humanoid robot soldiers, silently guarding Han Xiao's left and right sides.

The robot warriors had bright yellow, white, and black alloy shells. Their four limbs were the same as human beings, and they were two meters tall. Their armor was not bulky, but it was not light either. They were at the right size. Their heads were shaped like the beak of a knight's helmet, and on their backs were two wing-like propulsion wings. Their palms were four-fingered, and it was impossible to tell what weapons these two robots were equipped with.

At the same time, Harmon had already arrived in front of Han Xiao. With a fierce twist of his waist, his door-sized warhammer swung in an arc, sweeping towards Han Xiao from the side. The power behind this strike was clearly much greater than before, causing a violent gale to surge up!

Whoosh!

Before the hammer arrived, the strong wind already made it difficult for Han Xiao to open his eyes!

This hammer attack was obviously meant to send both Han Xiao and the robot flying. If he was hit by this attack, Han Xiao would probably trigger the Strength Suppression effect, and he would probably be stunned for a short period of time. After all, his Strength attribute was not high. Even if his health was extremely tanky, it would not feel good.

Han Xiao didn't panic at all. His eyes flashed.

"Philip, load the data."

Weng!

The two deathly still robots shuddered and immediately began to move. Their movements were smooth and natural, without the slightest hint of mechanical stiffness.

The robot on the left rapidly extended both hands, causing its mechanical arms to split apart. Numerous mechanical parts extended out, causing the arms to instantly expand by a size, transforming into a heavy soldier form. Its palms grabbed the hammer head, and the propellers on its back began to operate at full power, causing chaotic airflow to erupt.

Dang!

The warhammer was forcibly blocked. In terms of Strength, it was actually not suppressed by Harmon!

The robot on the other side clasped its arms together, causing a small crack to appear in the middle of its armguard. It flickered with a faint blue light, sucking in large amounts of air, causing a sharp whistle to ring out. Following which, both of its fists punched out, causing a highly compressed air cannon to shoot out like a hurricane.

Harmon's chest felt stuffy, and like a large tree being uprooted by the wind, he was sent flying over a hundred meters away, smashing into the wall of the training room.

Bang!

The wall caved in, causing Harmon's entire body to sink into it.

"The combat results are not bad." Han Xiao glanced at the two robots on his left and right.

In Han Technician's Mech Legion, other than mechanical beasts, elite machines were also indispensable. In comparison, mechanical beasts were like minions, while elite machines were like mini-bosses. These two robot warriors were one of the elite machines.

The elite robot warriors in the legion were controlled by Philip's large amount of data and could carry out highly complex combat actions. The weapons and armor they were equipped with were all the same. I specially came over to take a look when you were sparring with Harmon, thinking that I would be able to see you in a sorry state. "Herlous laughed.

"Sorry to disappoint you." Han Xiao rolled his eyes. "Is there anything else?"

Herlous stopped smiling, coughed, and said, "That … I would like to ask when you will fulfill your promise to me."

"I have promised you many things. Which one are you talking about?"

Herlous raised his left mechanical arm, his face filled with anticipation. "You told me in the past that there was someone in your hometown who could restore my broken arm. Your mechanical prosthetic arm is quite comfortable … but I still miss the original."

"Oh, about that." Han Xiao suddenly understood. Herlous' arm had been shattered by Ashes, and Aurora's Esper Ability could heal his disability.

Rubbing his brows, Han Xiao felt a headache coming on. Although Aurora had such an ability, this was a sensitive matter. Aurora was so cute and passionate, so she definitely would not reject his help. The main problem was Hella, who always had a poker face. He did not know if her reaction would be as extreme as before.
